subject: general
question: Select the pair that is NOT matched correctly (the desert to it's location).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalahari Desert - India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 4** is incorrect because the Kalahari Desert is located in Southern Africa, not India.
 
• The **Great Victoria Desert** is correctly located in Australia.
 
• The **Patagonian Desert** is correctly located in Argentina.
 
• The **Sahara Desert** is correctly located on the African continent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Kalahari Desert** spans parts of Botswana, Namibia, and South Africa.
 
• Deserts are typically characterized by low rainfall, extreme temperatures, and sparse vegetation.
 
• These geographical locations are significant for understanding global climate patterns and biodiversity.
